name: Keystone CRM
body:
> Tool · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Keystone (keystone.so) is TAG's internal work CRM: tasks, recurring work, client lead records and Scott's meeting recordings (Fathom). Claude drives it read-only through Kim-Main Chrome; Kim signs in and Claude never enters passwords.

# How it is used
- **Tasks:** `keystone.so/my-work`. Recurring work is set up as templates on `/recurring-tasks`.
- **Leads by source:** the Leads page per client (custom date range works through the URL). It is the lead source for the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker) and the [Client Report Dashboard](lib:brain-client-report-dashboard) (leads, jobs booked, revenue). The default view hides AI-flagged non-leads.
- **Meetings:** 33 Fathom meetings (Jun 4 to Aug 20, 2026) were read and summarized; 27 were not attributed to a client, so their action items do not reach client portals; 79 action items were open as of Aug 20.
- Summit's custom lead form sends to GHL, Keystone and email.
- Monthly manual leads-by-source pull for the Website Pages sheet; next noted for Oct 29.

# Pending (from handoffs)
- Close the stale "Shift Google Ads budget to LSA" action item.
- Recreate a weekly Google Ads recurrence for the new Ads owner (Kim's Ads tasks were deleted Jul 16).
- "Verify GHL sync + fix attribution" (Pipeliners) is unowned.
